title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
tagline: Through the wardrobe. Mind the Turkish delight.
about: Four children step through a wardrobe into Narnia and join Aslan against the White Witch.
cue: Serve dessert when the White Witch offers Edmund the Turkish delight.

Come in out of the snow, Lucy. There's tea, toast, sardines and cake, and a story or two.
Mind the cake trolley on your way in.
